description: handle_mailbox_query returns unsupportedSort error for any non-empty sort array, including the RFC 8621 §2.3 required sort properties (name, sortOrder). Fix: implement at least name and sortOrder sorting in handle_mailbox_query. Oracle: RFC 8621 §2.3 — name and sortOrder are listed as valid Mailbox sort comparator properties, jmap-test-suite mailbox-query.test.ts conformance_mailbox_query_sort_by_name.
title: jmap-mail-server: Mailbox/query sort unsupported
